description: Duplicates a post by creating a new WIP post with the same name and body_md as the source post. By default the duplicate is created in the source team; specify targetTeamName to duplicate into a different team.

postNumber.description: The source post number to duplicate

targetTeamName.description: The destination team name for the duplicated post. Defaults to the source team when omitted.

teamName.description: Team name (required). Use esa_get_teams first to see available teams.

name: esa_duplicate_post
title: Duplicate a post
